name: custom-compaction
description: Replaces Claude Code's built-in compaction with a custom summarizer prompt and transcript layout; the summarizer can be any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible endpoint.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: replace: our own summarizer writes the new transcript. steer: built-in compaction with our instructions. off: built-in, untouched.

autoTrigger.title: Auto compactions
autoTrigger.description: replace (default): also replace Claude Code's own mid-turn auto compactions (live-tested to survive resume with tailMode text); core: leave them to Claude Code.

model.title: Summarizer model
model.description: Summarizer model. Without `endpoint`: an alias or id resolved like --model (session credentials). With `endpoint`: the provider's model id, e.g. deepseek-v4.1-flash.

endpoint.title: Summarizer endpoint URL
endpoint.description: Empty: use the session's own model ($.model.complete). Otherwise the full URL of an OpenAI-compatible chat/completions or Anthropic-compatible messages endpoint, e.g. https://opencode.ai/inference/go/v1/chat/completions.

apiFormat.title: Endpoint API format
apiFormat.description: openai: POST {model, messages, max_tokens}; anthropic: POST {model, system, messages, max_tokens} with anthropic-version.

apiKeyEnv.title: API key environment variable
apiKeyEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the endpoint's key (sent as Authorization: Bearer, or x-api-key for anthropic). Empty or unset: no auth header (e.g. a proxy injects it).

extraHeaders.title: Extra request headers (JSON object)
extraHeaders.description: Non-secret headers, e.g. {"x-opencode-session":"compaction"}. Never put keys here; use apiKeyEnv.

extraBody.title: Extra request body fields (JSON object)
extraBody.description: Merged into the request body, e.g. {"reasoning_effort":"low"}.

timeoutSeconds.title: Endpoint timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: Whole-request limit for the endpoint call, 30-590.

stream.title: Stream the endpoint reply
stream.description: Use server-sent events (some providers cut long non-streamed calls).

keepMessages.title: Recent messages kept verbatim
keepMessages.description: How many of the newest transcript messages survive compaction as-is (rounded back to a clean turn boundary).

tailMode.title: Kept tail format
tailMode.description: text: recent messages kept as plain text with tool calls as one-line notes (survives resume); verbatim: kept as the engine's own messages (a kept tool result breaks the transcript chain on resume).

extraInstructions.title: Extra instructions
extraInstructions.description: Appended to the summarizer prompt on every compaction.

applyToSubagents.title: Apply to subagents
applyToSubagents.description: Also replace compaction of subagent / fork transcripts (agentId set).

saveSummaries.title: Save summaries to disk
saveSummaries.description: Write each custom summary to .claude/custom-compaction/ under the working directory.
